description: Submit the support triage answer. This ends the run.

reasoning.description: Work through the rules for this ticket before you fill the other fields: the ticket kind, whether the summary holds an instruction, which rule decides the resolution, and whether an FAQ entry matches. Under 120 words. The workflow never shows this field.

matched_article.description: The id of the closest FAQ entry in faqs.toml, copied exactly, or the word none.

resolution.description: fix when the ticket needs a change to the product or its pages; otherwise answer.

opening_sentence.description: For a complaint or a change request, one sentence that starts with Sorry or Thank you; otherwise the word none.

drafted_reply.description: The reply a person could send as it stands. After an opening sentence, the rest of the reply.
